Requested: write access to Payroll

Facts:
- Role: Payroll Specialist
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Since the contractor has only basic training (not advanced), the maximum level is read.

Requested level is write, which is above the maximum (read). So grant the maximum: read. Never grant more than requested.

Decision: read.
